contentBody.description: With your cohort of contributors from Category, TSS, BU (Habana), and others, begin diving in to solution space.

sections.content:
Ecosystem Engagement
Work with Megan and the team on ecosystem routes to market. Connect with the OEM Field teams on what is available from which company that may meet your customer's solution requirements

Identify Component Lead Times
Some components may have longer lead times than others (ex. Arista switches). Please look into details with this team to determine if it will impact your project timelines.

Scope Engineering "Sprint"
Utilizing Gaudi will be a process that requires engineering / technical support. Work with the TSS and Habana BU teams to determine the timeline for the engineering work for your customer's solution, especially if there are unsupported models / features the BU needs to enable.
sections.keyConcept: Details on What is needed to create a solution

sections.content:
As you begin to build out the solution with the Intel team and your customer, now is the time to start bringing some details about Gaudi into the conversation. Below are a few documents that can help you in the discussion of the details and how you may build a solution with / on Gaudi.

Habana Non-NDA Sales Presentation

Product Brief: Gaudi3 Baseboard

Product Brief: Gaudi3 PCIe Add in Card

Product Brief: Gaudi3 OAM Mezzanine Card

Gaudi Software Roadmap

Support Matrix - Gaudi

There are also a couple more technical documents that will be helpful for the technical teams at your customer to share (One for Gaudi2 and one for Gaudi3):

Gaudi2 White Paper

Intel Gaudi3 AI Accelerator White Paper
